title: A Flashbots native confirmation is treated as success without reading the transaction receipt status

evidence.note: returns the hash at once when nativeConfirmed

evidence.ref: sed -n 566,574p and grep revertingTxHashes in the base snapshot (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: lines re-read; the strategy simulates first and sets no revertingTxHashes, so relays should drop a reverting bundle. Not reproduced.

sibling_sites_checked: Other inclusion decisions (reconciliation.ts:373-378, :405-407; passthrough.ts) do read a receipt.
severity_rationale: S3 candidate: relay rules should make a status-0 inclusion impossible, so a receipt check is defence in depth.
recommendation: Read the receipt status before reporting a native confirmation as success; decide in card TX-01. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
